property_summary: For any address and any amount, once a Put call completes successfully, a subsequent Put from any address must also complete successfully (the reentrancy mutex is reset after each call); the mutant never resets locked_, so every second Put reverts.
change_summary: Delete the `locked_ = false;` statement so the mutex never resets and every subsequent Put call reverts.
